name: 左品牌區＋資訊文字＋右按鈕與小圖示連結
desc: 左右兩區的簡潔頁尾：左側是標誌、一排小型文字連結與多行次要資訊文字，右側上方是按鈕、下方是一排小圖示連結與一行小字。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的頁尾，放在頁面最下方，跟著頁面捲動。左右分成兩區，內容對齊頁面內容寬度：左側約三分之二是品牌區，右側約三分之一的元素都靠右。左側最上方放標誌，標誌右側同一行可放一段說明文字；標誌下方可放一排橫向排列的小型文字連結；再往下是多行次要資訊文字，可分成數組，每組是一行小標加上次要文字；沒有內容的元素省略，其他元素的位置不變。右側上方放主要按鈕，頂端和標誌那一行對齊；右側下方放一排小圖示連結，其下一行小字，底緣和左側最後一行對齊，按鈕與這兩者之間留空白；圖示連結和小字沒有時省略。標誌約佔內容寬度的六分之一，按鈕、連結和小字都明顯小於標誌；頁尾內沒有分隔線。
mobile: 左右兩區改為上下排列，內容靠左：標誌與說明文字在最上方，其下依序是小型文字連結、次要資訊文字，再來是主要按鈕、一排小圖示連結，最下方是一行小字；小型文字連結放不下時換行。

en.name: Left brand block with info text + right button and icon links
en.desc: A simple two-zone footer: the left side holds the logo, a row of small text links and several lines of secondary text; the right side has a button at the top and a row of small icon links with a line of small text at the bottom.
en.prompt: Create a footer whose height is determined by its content, placed at the very end of the page and scrolling with it. It is split into two zones aligned to the page content width: the left two-thirds is the brand block, and the elements in the right third are right-aligned. At the top left place the logo; a description may sit to its right on the same line; below the logo there may be a row of small text links laid out horizontally; further down are several lines of secondary text, which may be split into several groups, each a small heading followed by secondary text; omit any element without content, without changing the position of the other elements. At the top of the right side place a primary button whose top aligns with the logo line; at the bottom of the right side place a row of small icon links with a line of small text below it, its bottom edge aligned with the last line on the left, leaving empty space between the button and these two; omit the icon links and small text when there is no content. The logo is about one-sixth of the content width, and the button, links and small text are all clearly smaller than the logo; there are no dividers inside the footer.
en.mobile: The two zones stack vertically and are left-aligned: the logo and description at the top, followed in order by the small text links, the secondary text, the primary button, the row of small icon links, and finally the line of small text at the bottom; the small text links wrap when they do not fit.
